chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 194: Keke's Wrath Against Sacred Beasts
chapter_meta_description: Keke unleashes its fury on four sacred beasts that hurt the Little Defiant Dragon. White Tiger falls, Golden Ape loses lives, and a moment of mercy changes everything. A brutal yet tender chapter.
og_title: World of Immortality: Keke's Rampage Against Sacred Beasts
og_description: The white beast goes on the warpath, toppling sacred beasts and healing its wounded ally. A chapter of fury, mercy, and divine power.
